name: @nuxeo/satori-cli
$tagsComment: A Node tool, and nothing may import it: no depConstraint in eslint.config.mjs lists `type:tool`. Its sources are .mjs, which the module-boundary rule does not read; what they import is the package pipeline in scripts/package-pipeline/, the helpers beside it in scripts/, and libs/shared/app-definition, the app definition's contract, which a tool may use. build.mjs bundles all of it with esbuild into dist/tools/satori-cli/, which runs with Node alone and has no dependency: the build refuses one from node_modules.

build.$inputsComment: Everything the bundle is made from, which nothing in the project graph links to this project: the pipeline's modules and helpers, the app definition's library and its schemas, the config-package generator's builder, scaffolder and templates, the platform's English catalogue, the sources the upgrade check reads of the platform for platform/platform.json, and the server's validator.js, which the build holds to the library.

test.$comment: selftest.mjs builds the tool into a scratch folder of its own, packs it with npm, and runs it outside this repository under Node's permission model, so it needs no build target first.
test.$inputsComment: The build's inputs, plus what the controls compare the tool with and run it on: scripts/app-package.mjs and the entry points beside it, the validator's bin.mjs, every kit, the npm launcher the pack goes through, and the generator's own copy of the names Satori uses.

lint.$comment: Declared rather than inferred: @nx/eslint/plugin infers `eslint:lint`, which `nx affected -t lint` does not match (see tools/satori-generators/project.json).
